commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== pre-baseline boot id =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "== install aide =="
sudo -n dnf install -y aide
echo "== configure aide for /etc scope =="
sudo -n cp /etc/aide.conf /etc/aide.conf.orig.bak
sudo -n tee /etc/aide.conf >/dev/null <<'CONF'
# Antrieb integrity baseline: focused on /etc
database=file:/var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz
database_out=file:/var/lib/aide/aide.db.new.gz
gzip_dbout=yes
verbose=5
report_url=file:/var/log/aide/aide.log
report_url=stdout

# Rule definitions
All=p+i+n+u+g+s+m+c+acl+selinux+xattrs+sha256

/etc All
CONF
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/aide /var/log/aide
echo "== initialize baseline database =="
sudo -n aide --init --config=/etc/aide.conf
sudo -n mv /var/lib/aide/aide.db.new.gz /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz
echo "== baseline file info =="
sudo -n ls -la /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz
sudo -n sha256sum /var/lib/aide/aide.db.gz
echo "== run check against fresh baseline (expect no differences) =="
sudo -n aide --check --config=/etc/aide.conf | tee /tmp/aide-check-baseline.log || true
tail -n 40 /tmp/aide-check-baseline.log
echo "== simulate a later change detection smoke test =="
sudo -n touch /etc/aide-integrity-smoketest.conf
sudo -n aide --check --config=/etc/aide.conf > /tmp/aide-check-after-change.log 2>&1 || true
grep -E "Total number of (new|changed|removed) files|aide-integrity-smoketest" /tmp/aide-check-after-change.log || true
echo "== cleanup smoke test file and restore baseline state =="
sudo -n rm -f /etc/aide-integrity-smoketest.conf
sudo -n aide --check --config=/etc/aide.conf > /tmp/aide-check-restored.log 2>&1 || true
tail -n 20 /tmp/aide-check-restored.log
echo "== enable periodic check timer if available =="
systemctl list-unit-files | grep -i aide || true
echo "DONE"
